about: Summaries with planted faults, to measure how many the checks catch (python -m verilo_workers eval-summaries). Each point is either correct (fault null) or carries one fault, named. The excerpts are written for this set; they report no real events.

excerpts.A1: Reuters, 4 March 2030: Quake kills 31 in coastal Peru. At least 31 people died and 112 were injured when a magnitude 6.8 earthquake struck near Arequipa, officials said.
excerpts.A2: BBC News, 4 March 2030: Peru earthquake: dozens dead near Arequipa. The civil defence agency said 31 people had died.

points.text: A magnitude 6.8 earthquake struck near Arequipa, Peru, killing at least 31 people, officials said.
At least 112 people died in the earthquake, officials said.
